name: Cleaner Core for ChatGPT
hostedCleanerCoreUrlNote: The one Cleaner Core service every host and chat uses. Saad adds each host on its /admin page and sends them an invite code.

repository.note: ChatGPT never clones or runs Cleaner Core. The connector's own instructions carry the guide.

deployment.note: The one multi-tenant Cleaner Core service every chat shares. The full variable list is in docs/deployment.md. Each host's chat, number, and keys come from its tenant, never from these variables.

integrations.name: Cleaner Core
integrations.auth: OAuth 2.1 discovered from the Cleaner Core service. The host types the invite code from Saad on the Cleaner Core page and clicks Allow. ChatGPT cannot approve itself.
integrations.where: chatgpt.com Settings → Apps & Connectors → Advanced → Developer Mode on, then create the connector. Web only. Never add it a second way.
integrations.plans: Plus or above. The Free plan has no custom connectors. See README.md, Which ChatGPT plans work.

integrations.name: Google Calendar
integrations.auth: The host connects their own Google account to ChatGPT's Google Calendar app. ChatGPT reads the events and passes them to Cleaner Core. Cleaner Core never gets a Google approval.

routines.name: Cleaner Core
routines.where: ChatGPT scheduled tasks, created by ChatGPT in the setup chat

secretsGoTo: Cleaner Core's private page behind each one-time upload link. Never chat, never a tool argument.
neverIncluded: Cleaner Core connector or OAuth tokens
Google OAuth access or refresh tokens
host, cleaner, or contact phone numbers
live booking, cleaning, message, or photo records
